title: What are you freezing??
text: What are you freezing??. Love these, but the rolls are so thick that I can’t use my sealer cutter because they don’t fit in the area where the roll should be placed. They also don’t have an area anywhere on the sheets to write the contents and date. I have to use a sharpie and write the date on the outer side of the side seam and pray it doesn’t rub off.
